item.title: fix(plugins): restrict npm project cleanup to owned roots (#124608)
item.summary: fix(plugins): restrict npm project cleanup to owned roots (#124608) * fix(plugins): validate npm project root ownership Restrict recursive managed npm project deletion to canonical ordinary or exact generation roots. Preserve noncanonical sibling roots while retaining package-leaf cleanup and valid generation lifecycle behavior.\n\nFixes #123972 * fix(plugins): reject substituted npm project roots * fix(plugins): pin managed npm root identity * fix(plugins): revalidate npm package removals * fix(plugins): validate npm cleanup descendants * fix(plugins): reject npm cleanup symlink aliases * fix(plugins): bind npm cleanup to planned root kind
